title: Lung Ultrasound to Detect Pulmonary Complications in Critically Ill Parturients
brief_summary: This study aims at describing the frequency, timing and type of pulmonary complications detected with lung ultrasound in critically-ill parturients in admitted to a high-dependency unit in Freetown, Sierra Leone.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admitted to the HDU of the PCMH during the study period
* Verbal informed consent of the patient or his/her formal representative

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lung ultrasound not feasible, e.g., due to electricity breakdown, or absence of the trained sonographer.
study_population: Critically ill parturients admitted to the HDU of the Princess Christian Maternity Hospital (PCMH) in Freetown, Sierra Leone.
